post.description: Moves the admission to DISCHARGE_INITIATED, records the transition, and notifies every pharmacy the admission ordered from — in that order, as one operation. The status commits before any pharmacy is contacted, so a pharmacy is never told about a discharge that did not happen. A pharmacy that could not be reached comes back as `pharmacy_warning` and never fails the request.

post.description:
Invoices the given charges (all un-invoiced charges when `chargeIds` is omitted), with an optional bill-level discount. Running room meters are billed up to now unless `meterIds` says otherwise.

The admission must be on new billing (`use_new_billing`); otherwise this returns 409. Returns 503 when billing is not configured on the server, and 502 when the billing service fails.

chargeIds.description: Charges to invoice; omit for every un-invoiced charge.

invoiceDiscount.description: Bill-level discount on the whole invoice.

meterIds.description: Running room meters to bill up to now onto this invoice. Omit = all running meters; `[]` = none.

post.summary: Bill part of a room meter
post.description:
Bills one interval of a running room meter as a charge (every un-billed night when `from`/`to` are omitted). The meter keeps running, and cancelling the invoice the charge lands on frees the interval to be billed again.

The admission must be on new billing (`use_new_billing`); otherwise this returns 409. Returns 503 when billing is not configured on the server, and 502 when the billing service fails.

from.description: Start of the interval to bill (ISO date-time).

to.description: End of the interval to bill (ISO date-time).
